name: London public contracts (Contracts Finder)
gives: Procurement notices London buyers published on the UK government's Contracts Finder in the last 24 hours: notice page, stage, title, buyer (mostly public bodies, sometimes an agent publishing for one), value, award value and deadline. No supplier or contact is kept.
how: sources/contracts-finder/collect.mjs reads https://www.contractsfinder.service.gov.uk/ (twice a day, at data.b@'s wakes; the source's own cadence: every 6 hours)

terms.summary: Open Government Licence v3.0: every OCDS package carries the licence; reuse with attribution. robots.txt has no rules (page not found). The published search needs no token. Natural persons are not kept (suppliers can be sole traders). Not reviewed by a person.
